house_style: Rich gouache and colored-pencil painted illustration for a Grade 9 math launch range. assets.name: lp-field-dusk

assets.prompt: An open sports field at dusk, short green grass in the bottom eighth, deep blue sky with first stars, low distant dark trees. Tall open sky for a ball flight, foreground grass blades, layered atmospheric distance.
